title: Newbies Start Here
description: Newbies Start Here — The Townstons wiki
html:
Are you brand new to Dungeon Runners, or maybe just considering joining the game? Here are the first links for you to check out.

The Beginners Trail leads from one article in this list to the next. Look for it at the bottom of each page.

  • The article "I'm in Dew Valley, Now What?" will be your first stop. It will probably raise lots of questions that you want answered.
  • The Beginner's FAQ will answer lots of those questions.
  • Read the starter article on Basic Builds for Newbies.
  • Read the Interface Guide. It is long and detailed but has lots of good information you will need!
  • Check out the map and description of Dew Valley.
  • Check out the Dew Valley Quests
  • Check the Monsters as you encounter them.
  • When you come to the end of Dew Valley Forest, read the Rattletooth Boss Guide.
  • Then read the information on Townston.
  • Check out the Dungeon page on Algernon.

By this point, you should be pretty familiar with this wiki. Read the FAQ about the wiki, and then just hop around finding information as you need it! Very soon, you will be ready to CONTRIBUTE!

The Beginners Trail now leads to "I'm in Dew Valley, Now What?".
